sources.title: KidIkaros/abliterated-minicpm5-2b-ggml · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This is an abliterated version of MiniCPM5-2B (~2.8B dense parameters) with refusal directions removed across 20 strong layers (layers 13, 17, 20-41). The model has 100% refusal removal on harmful prompts while maintaining ~97% perplexity retention.

sources.title: MiniCPM5-2B - Intelligence, Performance & Price Analysis | Artificial Analysis
sources.snippet: The model supports text input, outputs text, and has a 131k tokens context window with knowledge up to December 2025. MiniCPM5-2B scores 13 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, placing it well above average among comparable models ...
